Privacy · clear by design

Privacy without the fog.

The public tools do not require an account, and London Advanced does not retain the locations, preferences or answers you enter into them. A small amount of personal data is processed only when you subscribe, contact Paolo, consent to analytics, or when technical providers deliver and secure the site.

Last updated 25 October 2026
01Who is responsible

Paolo Pastorino is the controller for personal data handled through London Advanced. For a privacy request, use the contact form and write “Privacy request” at the start of the message.

02What is processed
ActivityData and purposeBasis and retention
Public toolsLocations, dates, preferences and answers are used to calculate or display the requested result. Where location permission is used, the browser shares coordinates only after you allow it.London Advanced does not create an account, profile or history from these inputs and does not retain them in its own database after the request. Hosting and external data providers may keep limited technical logs under their own policies.
Contact formName, email address and message are sent by email so Paolo can read and answer the enquiry. The website does not store a second database copy.Legitimate interests in answering genuine enquiries. Correspondence is normally deleted within 12 months after the last relevant exchange, unless it is needed longer for a legal, security or ongoing business reason.
NewsletterEmail address and, where configured, the signup source are sent to EmailOctopus to deliver the requested newsletter and keep evidence of subscription preferences.Consent. The record is kept until you unsubscribe or ask for deletion; a minimal suppression record may be retained to honour an unsubscribe request.
Optional Google AnalyticsUsage and device information helps understand which pages and links are useful. Google Analytics loads only after an affirmative choice.Consent. London Advanced limits analytics data retention to no more than 14 months. Google may process data outside the UK under its safeguards.
Site delivery and securityCloudflare may process IP address, request time, browser/device data, requested URL and security signals to deliver, protect and monitor the site. Cloudflare Web Analytics provides aggregated measurement without placing its own cookies or using local storage.Legitimate interests in operating a secure and reliable service. Provider security and diagnostic logs are kept for the periods set by the relevant service and account configuration.
03Cookies and local storage
  • Analytics choice: la-analytics-consent stores “yes” or “no” in the browser so the site remembers the choice. It remains until cleared.
  • Anti-spam: la_contact_recent and la_subscribe_recent are strictly necessary cookies lasting 60 seconds after a successful form submission.
  • Google Analytics: if you consent, Google may set analytics cookies. Refusing does not restrict the site or its public tools.

04Providers and links

London Advanced uses Cloudflare for hosting, security and aggregated analytics; Google Analytics only with consent; EmailOctopus for newsletters; and Google Fonts for typography. Individual tools may call map, transport, weather or venue data services to answer a request. Following an external link—such as Payhip, an organiser, a map or a social network—takes you to that provider’s service and privacy terms. Read the Cloudflare privacy policy, Google privacy policy and EmailOctopus privacy policy.

05Your choices and rights

You may ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or a copy of personal data, object where legitimate interests are relied on, and withdraw consent at any time. These rights are subject to legal limits. Newsletter consent can also be withdrawn through the unsubscribe link in every email. London Advanced does not sell personal data and does not use contact or newsletter details for third-party advertising. If a concern is not resolved, you may complain to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office.

06Security, children and changes

Reasonable technical and organisational safeguards are used, but no internet service can promise absolute security. Do not send sensitive personal information through the contact form. London Advanced is a general travel and culture service, not a service directed at children, and does not knowingly collect children’s data. This notice may be updated when the site, providers or law changes; the date at the top will change.

A practical note

These pages describe how the site currently works and may be updated when services or duties change. Use the contact form for a specific request.
